mapper.select: SELECT tdm50_check_ym FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND COALESCE(tdm50_end_yn,'false') != 'true' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm51_chck_org INNER JOIN tdm52_chck_manl ON tdm52_chck_org_id = tdm51_chck_org_id WHERE tdm51_chck_job_id = tdm50_chck_job_id ) ORDER BY tdm50_check_ym DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (t.tdm50_end_yn = 'true') AS end_yn , TO_CHAR(t.tdm50_end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date FROM ( ( SELECT a.* , b.apr01_appr_id AS tdm50_appr_id , b.apr01_status_cd AS tdm50_appr_status_cd , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', b.apr01_status_cd, b.apr01_company_id, b.apr01_reg_date) AS tdm50_appr_status_nm , ( SELECT CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(c.tdm53_lock_yn = 'true') THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END FROM tdm53_chck_exct c WHERE c.tdm53_check_ym = a.tdm50_check_ym AND c.tdm53_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id ) AS tdm50_lock_yn , COALESCE(tdm91_batch_check_use_yn, 'false') AS tdm50_batch_check_use_yn , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(a.tdm50_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), '') AS tdm50_upd_date_str FROM tdm50_chck_job a LEFT OUTER JOIN tdm91_company_setup ON ( tdm91_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id AND tdm91_start_date = ( SELECT MAX(tdm91_start_date) FROM tdm91_company_setup WHERE tdm91_company_id = a.tdm50_company_id AND tdm91_start_date <= a.tdm50_start_date ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM tdm56_chck_relate_appr INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm56_appr_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN apr01_status_cd = '10' THEN 1 WHEN apr01_status_cd = '20' THEN 2 WHEN apr01_status_cd = '30' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END , apr01_appr_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) b ON b.tdm56_relate_table_id = a.tdm50_chck_job_id WHERE a.tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND a.tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm} ) UNION ALL SELECT f_create_seq() AS tdm50_chck_job_id , #{companyId} AS tdm50_company_id , #{checkYm} AS tdm50_check_ym , #{checkYm}||' 책무 이행점검' AS tdm50_check_nm , NULL AS tdm50_start_date , NULL AS tdm50_end_date , 'false' AS tdm50_end_yn , NULL AS tdm50_upd_nm , f_sysdate() AS tdm50_upd_date , NULL AS tdm50_appr_id , NULL AS tdm50_appr_status_cd , NULL AS tdm50_appr_status_nm , 'false' AS tdm50_lock_yn , 'false' AS tdm50_batch_check_use_yn , NULL AS tdm50_upd_date_str WHERE 1=1 AND false = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm} ) ) t

SELECT tdm54_chck_insuff_id AS chck_insuff_id , tdm54_occ_ym AS check_ym /*발생년월*/ , TO_CHAR(tdm54_due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date , TO_CHAR(tdm54_action_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS action_date , TO_CHAR(COALESCE(tdm54_action_date, tdm54_due_date), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS action_due_date , f_cdnm( 'TdmInsuffStatus' , CASE WHEN tdm54_occ_ym = #{checkYm} THEN '10' WHEN tdm54_action_date IS NULL THEN '11' WHEN tdm54_action_appr_ym > #{checkYm} THEN '11' ELSE tdm54_status_cd END , tdm54_company_id, tdm54_reg_date) AS status_name /*조치상태*/ , org00_kor_nm AS org_name /*조치부서*/ , emp00_kor_nm AS action_emp_name /*조치(예정)자*/ , tdm54_action_nm AS action_name FROM tdm54_chck_insuff CROSS JOIN ( SELECT tdm50_chck_job.* FROM tdm50_chck_job WHERE tdm50_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm50_check_ym = #{checkYm} ) tdm50 INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, tdm50_start_date) ON emp00_person_id = COALESCE(tdm54_action_emp_id, tdm54_plan_action_emp_id) INNER JOIN getOrg(#{companyId}, tdm50_start_date) ON org00_org_id = tdm54_org_id WHERE tdm54_company_id = #{companyId} AND tdm54_occ_ym <= #{checkYm} AND 'Y' = (CASE WHEN tdm54_status_cd = '25' AND tdm54_action_appr_ym < #{checkYm} THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, tdm50_start_date, true) WHERE tdm30_person_id = #{exctId} AND tdm30_role_id = tdm54_role_id )
ORDER BY tdm54_occ_ym, org00_kor_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8", tdm54_chck_insuff_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT tdm30.* , COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') AS tdm30_appr_status_cd FROM getTdm30RoleAllc(#{companyId}, CAST(#{stdDate} AS DATE), false) tdm30 LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = tdm30_appr_id WHERE tdm30_person_id = #{exctId} ) t

SELECT t.emp03_org_code_id AS org_code_id , ( SELECT o.org00_kor_nm FROM org00_org_info o WHERE o.org00_org_code_id = t.emp03_org_code_id AND o.org00_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY o.org00_mod_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS kor_name FROM ( SELECT emp03_org_code_id FROM emp03_trans WHERE emp03_person_id = #{personId} AND emp03_trans_cd != '800' ORDER BY emp03_trans_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) t
